record.question: What does the term Azotaemia mean?
options: Elevated level of nitrogenous waste products in the blood
Elevated level of uric acid in the blood
Elevated level of adenosine de-aminase level in the blood
Elevated level of chylomicrons in the blood
record.explanation: Answer A: Elevated level of nitrogenous waste products in the blood. Azotemia means elevated nitrogenous waste products, especially urea and creatinine, in blood. Reference: https://www.merckmanuals.com/professional/genitourinary-disorders/approach-to-the-patient-with-genitourinary-disorders/approach-to-the-patient-with-genitourinary-disorders. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
